seed_expert_discoveries.project: Model Routing for Optimal Use Cases
seed_expert_discoveries.technical_takeaway: Automatically route queries to specialized models: Fable 5 (hard-coding), GPT 5 Sol (data analysis), Flash 3.7 (research), SeeDance 2.5 (video), Opus 5 (design), Kimi K3 (cheap agentic), Grok 4.6 (real-time), GPT Image 2 (image), Qwen 3.8 27B (classifier). Qwen 3.8 27B highlighted as strong open-source small model for fast inference and classifiers.

Periodically use larger models to create deterministic 'compound tools' (composed of primitive tools) that smaller models can reliably use without errors; acts as 'muscle memory' for frequent sequences.
